signals.name: VTEC valve control
signals.description: VTEC works by switching between two (or sometimes three) different camshaft profiles by engaging or disengaging a mechanism that locks the valve rocker arms together. When VTEC is OFF, the engine operates using the standard cam profile, which is typically optimized for fuel efficiency and low-end torque. When VTEC is ON, the system switches to a high-performance cam profile that allows the valves to open wider and for a longer duration, enabling better airflow at higher RPMs for increased power.

signals.name: VTEC valve control
signals.description: VTEC works by switching between two (or sometimes three) different camshaft profiles by engaging or disengaging a mechanism that locks the valve rocker arms together. When VTEC is OFF, the engine operates using the standard cam profile, which is typically optimized for fuel efficiency and low-end torque. When VTEC is ON, the system switches to a high-performance cam profile that allows the valves to open wider and for a longer duration, enabling better airflow at higher RPMs for increased power.

Traction battery current
signals.description: Signed pack current from the drive-motor/power-electronics controller (negative = charging). Confirmed -22.75 A at a steady 9.22 kW AC charge and +0.9 A accessory draw in Ready. Same register family as Chevy Bolt 7E1 222414.

signals.name: Traction battery nominal voltage
signals.description: Constant rated (nominal) pack voltage, 352.1 V on a 2025 LYRIQ - identical while charging at 70% SOC and at rest at 80% SOC, so it is not a live measurement. Duplicates at 2428/242D/2434/2489.

signals.name: 12V battery voltage
signals.description: 12 V system voltage from the Drive Motor Control Module (matches Chevrolet-Equinox-EV DA1D 2233E5). Note: LYRIQ command_support docs list this DID as HV pack voltage - on-vehicle it reads 13.1-13.9 V under DC-DC float and does not track pack voltage.
